content.summary: A graphite illustrator completes and colors an adult bicycle mechanic. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: The physical drawing tool remains visible. + Every contour emerges from current tool contact. + Anatomy and props complete in dependency order. + Color waits for closed line regions. + The tool exits before the finished artwork holds.
quick_start.recommended_input: Show one adult illustrator's hand refining a light construction sketch of an original adult bicycle mechanic. Complete jacket, tool belt, bicycle wheel and planted feet as coherent connected line art. Add three small motion marks beside the wheel, lift the pencil fully and hold the completed page.
